description:
Gretel figured out pretty quickly that refusing to walk comes with perks 😂

Our producer Parham can't have a dog of his own just yet, so he borrows everyone else's. From refusing to walk every few minutes to convincing Parham to carry her and ending the day with a hot dog at a baseball game, Gretel got the VIP ballpark experience 🌭⚾
